---
title: "Hands-on Exercise 6"
subtitle: "Spatio-Temporal Point Patterns Analysis"
---

This exercise extends point-pattern analysis into time, showing how the location and intensity of events evolve across temporal intervals.

::: {.chapter-link}
[Open the course reference for Chapter 6](https://r4gdsa.netlify.app/chap06){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

## Learning focus

- Prepare a study area and event data with valid spatial and temporal fields.
- Visualise point events across time.
- Compute spatio-temporal kernel density estimates by month and day of year.
- Compare alternative approaches to temporal grouping and KDE.
- Apply spatio-temporal point-pattern methods and interpret their outputs.

## Analysis workflow

1. Import and validate the study-area boundary.
2. Clean event coordinates, dates, and temporal attributes.
3. Explore how event counts and locations change over time.
4. Estimate and compare spatio-temporal density surfaces.
5. Interpret persistent, emerging, and changing concentrations with appropriate caveats.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Temporal aggregation can change the apparent pattern, so the selected time unit should match the analytical question.
:::
